name: loonaut
description: Find the nearest public toilet worldwide with the Loonaut MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Loonaut finds public toilets worldwide. Public search needs no login. Account access uses your Loonaut passkey through OAuth. It reads your partner listings and can monitor account changes while the relay is ready. Toilet data is © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
defaultPrompt: Where is the nearest public toilet to Darmstadt Hauptbahnhof?
